Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:10:1.english: For Rava said - In Bekhorot (59a).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:10:2.hebrew: מנין הראוי פוטר - היה לו עשרה טלאים, ומנה חמש, ומת אחד מן שאינו מנוין, המנוין פטורין, ושאינן מנוין מצטרפין לגורן אחר, שיולדו לו טלאים עד שיגיע זמן הגורן ויצטרפם עם אלו. אבל המנוין פטורין במנין הראוי. ויליף לה מאשר יעבור ולא שכבר עבר, דמשעבר תחת השבט ולא עלה בידו לעשר, שוב אינו מעבירו פעם אחרת כשיולדו לו טלאים לצרף עמהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:10:2.english: A tally fit [to reach ten] exempts - [If] he had ten lambs, and he counted five, and one of those that were not counted died, those that were counted are exempt, and those that were not counted combine for another tithing season, [so that] lambs will be born to him until the time of the tithing season arrives, and he will combine them with these. However, those that were counted are exempt by virtue of a tally fit [to reach ten]. And he derives this from "that passes" [Leviticus 27:32] — and not that which has already passed; for once it has passed under the rod and he did not end up tithing, he does not pass it [under] another time when lambs are born to him to combine with them.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:1:2.english: They kept away from it - From bathing in it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:1:3.hebrew: ואמר ליה רב אושעיא לרבה - גרסינן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:1:3.english: And Rav Oshaya said to Rabba - This is our reading.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:1:4.english: To Kafrei - The name of a place.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:1.english: When he came to Sura - As he was passing through Sura to go to Kafri.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:2.hebrew: ספק בכורות - כגון בהמה שילדה, ואין ידוע אם בכרה כבר, אם לא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:2.english: Uncertain firstborns - For example, an animal that gave birth, and it is not known whether it has already given birth previously, or not.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:3.hebrew: אחד בכור אדם - כגון שהפילה אמו לפניו, ספק דבר הפוטר בבכורה, ספק רוח הפילה, והבא אחריו בכור:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:3.english: Whether a human firstborn - For example, where his mother miscarried before him, [and there is] uncertainty whether [it was] something that exempts [subsequent offspring] from firstborn status or whether she miscarried [mere] wind, and the one that comes after it is [a doubtful] firstborn.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:4.english: Whether non-kosher [animals] - Such as the firstborn of a donkey.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:5.hebrew: המוציא מחבירו כו' - קס"ד, אם ביד ישראל הן, הוי כהן מוציא מחבירו, עליו הראיה; ואם תקפה כהן, ושתיק ישראל והדר צווח, הוי ישראל מוציא מחבירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:5.english: The one who extracts from his fellow, etc. - It enters your mind [that] if they are in the possession of the Israelite, the priest is the one extracting from his fellow, [and] the burden of proof rests upon him; and if a priest seized it, and the Israelite was silent and later cried out, the Israelite is the one extracting from his fellow.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:2:6.english: [They are] forbidden from shearing and work - Out of doubt, lest they are consecrated [animals].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:3:1.english: As it teaches: "He who extracts" - This implies whether [the one seeking to extract is] a priest or an Israelite.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:3:2.english: [They] are forbidden from shearing and labor - Out of doubt, lest they are consecrated [animals].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:3:3.hebrew: וכי לא תקפו - חמור כח הקדש לאוסרן בגיזה ועבודה. ש"מ: דאת"ל תקפו אין מוציאין אותו מידו — הקדישה מקודשת:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:3:3.english: And when he did not seize it - The power of consecration is stringent, forbidding them from shearing and labor. Learn from this that if you say [that if] he seized it, they do not remove it from his possession, [then if] he consecrated it [the bathhouse], it is consecrated.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:4:1.hebrew: לעולם אימא לך - גבי בכור, דאפילו תקפו כהן מוציאין אותו מידו, מסתמא בחזקת ישראל הן, ולעולם הכהן קרוי מוציא מחבירו. וטעמא דגיזה ועבודה לאו משום דיהא לכהן שום כח בהן, דתפשוט מינה להיכא דאי תקפו אין מוציאין מידו, הקדישה הוי הקדש, אלא הכא משום איסור ספק גיזת קדשים. וקדושה הבא מאליה שאני, שאם בכור הוא, מאליו קדוש, ואיכא לספוקי בהכי. אבל גבי מסותא, דאין קדושה באה אלא על פיו של זה, אימא לך, דאפי' אם תמצי לומר תקפה אין מוציאין, הקדישה בלא תקפה לא הוי הקדש, דאין יכול להקדיש דבר שאינו ברשותו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:4:1.english: Actually, I will say to you - Regarding a firstborn, even if a priest seized it, they remove it from his hand; ordinarily they are in the presumptive possession of the Israelite, and the priest is always considered the one who extracts from his fellow. And the reason for [the prohibition of] shearing and labor is not because the priest has any power in them, such that you could resolve from it that wherever, if he seized it, they do not remove it from his hand, if he consecrated it, it is consecrated; rather, here [it is] because of the prohibition of doubtful shearing of consecrated items, and sanctity that comes by itself is different, for if it is a firstborn, it is consecrated by itself, and there is doubt regarding this. But regarding the bathhouse, where sanctity comes only through the declaration of this [person], I will say to you that even if you should say [that] if he seized it they do not remove it, if he consecrated it without seizing it, it is not consecrated, for one cannot consecrate something that is not in his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:5:1.hebrew: דמסייע לך - דגבי ספק בכורות, אם תקפה כהן, מוציאין מידו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:5:1.english: That supports you - That regarding uncertain firstborns, if a priest seized it, [the court] removes it from his possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:5:2.hebrew: הספיקות - לקמן מפרש בספק פדיון פטר חמור, דמפריש עליו טלה לאפקועי איסורא, והוא לעצמו, שאין צריך ליתנו לכהן, שהמוציא מחבירו עליו הראיה. ופדיון פטר חמור בר עשורי הוא: אם יש לכהן י' פטרי חמורים שנפלו לו מבית אבי אמו ישראל, מפריש עליהם עשרה שיין ומעשרן, והן שלו. הלכך ספק פדיון פטר חמור ביד ישראל נכנס לדיר עם שאר טלאים שלו להתעשר, ואי נפקא בעשירי ליפוק:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:5:2.english: The uncertain [animals] - Below [7a], [the Gemara] explains [that this refers to] an uncertain redemption of a firstborn donkey, where [the owner] designates a lamb for it to remove the prohibition [against benefiting from the donkey], and it [belongs] to himself, as he is not required to give it to a priest, because the burden of proof rests on the claimant. And the redemption [lamb] of a firstborn donkey is subject to tithing: if a priest has ten firstborn donkeys that fell to him [as an inheritance] from the house of his maternal grandfather, an Israelite, he designates ten sheep for them and tithes them, and they are his. Therefore, an uncertain redemption [lamb] of a firstborn donkey in the possession of an Israelite enters the pen with his other lambs to be tithed, and if it emerges tenth, let it emerge [as tithe].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:6:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד - יש לכהן צד זכייה בו, נמצא זה, אם יצא בעשירי, פוטר ממונו בממונו של כהן:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:6:1.english: And if it enters your mind - [Then] the priest has an aspect of ownership in it. It turns out that this [owner], if [the animal] emerges as the tenth, is exempting his [own] property with the property of the priest.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:7:1.english: To the Master - Rabbah, who was his teacher.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:7:2.hebrew: אם בר חיובא הוא - אי האי גברא בר חיובא הוא לעשורי, שפדיון זה לאו פדיון פטר חמור שלו הוא, הרי יש לו י' טלאים וחייב לעשרן, שפיר קמעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:7:2.english: If he is subject to the obligation - If this man is subject to the obligation to tithe, in that this redemption [lamb] is not the redemption of his firstborn donkey, behold, he has ten lambs and is obligated to tithe them, [so] he tithes properly.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:7:3.hebrew: אי לאו בר חיובא הוא - שפדיון זה של כהן לא פטר ליה מידי, דתשעה לאו בני עשורי נינהו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:7:3.english: If he is not subject to the obligation - That this redemption [lamb] belonging to the priest did not exempt anything for him, for nine [animals] are not subject to tithing.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:1.hebrew: לאו מילתא היא דאמרי - דודאי סייעתא היא למר. דאי הוה צד זכייה לכהן ביה מספק, ואשתכח דכל הני טלאים ספק חייבים במעשר ספק אין חייבים, מספיקא לא הוי צריך לעשורינהו, כדקאמרת לעשורי ממה נפשך, דכל ספק חייב ספק פטור לאו בני עשורי נינהו, ואפילו היכא דאיכא למימר ממה נפשך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:1.english: That which I said is not correct - For [the baraita] is certainly a support for the Master [Rabba]: For if there were an aspect of entitlement for the priest in it due to the doubt, and it turned out that all of these lambs are doubtful whether they are obligated in the tithe or not obligated, out of doubt he would not need to tithe them, as you said, to tithe [them] whichever way you look at it; for anything that is doubtful whether it is obligated or exempt is not subject to tithing, even where one could say "whichever way you look at it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:2.hebrew: קפץ אחד מן המנויין כו' - היה מעשר טלאים, והתחיל למנות כשהיו יוצאים בפתח הדיר, ועד שלא הגיע לעשרה, קפץ אחד מן המנויין לתוך הדיר, ואינו מכירו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:2.english: [If] one of those counted jumped, etc. - [One] was tithing lambs and began counting as they were exiting through the entrance of the pen, and before he reached ten, one of those counted jumped [back] into the pen, and he does not recognize it.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:3.hebrew: כולם פטורין - בין אותן שיצאו, בין אותן שבתוך הדיר, ואפילו הן אלף. שיצאו פטורין, (שהם) מנין הראוי, שכשמנאן היה המנין ראוי להשלים ולבא לכלל מעשר, ואמרינן בבכורות, והכי מייתינן לה: מנין הראוי פוטר. ואותן שבתוך הדיר פטורין משום זה המעורב, דכל אשר יעבור תחת השבט אמר רחמנא, ולא שעבר כבר, וכל חד מינייהו ספק כבר עבר הוא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:8:3.english: All of them are exempt - Both those that exited and those that are inside the pen, even if they are a thousand. Those that exited are exempt, (for they are) a fit count, for when he counted them, the count was fit to be completed and to reach the status of tithe; and we say in Bekhorot, and that is how we cite it: "A fit count exempts." And those that are inside the pen are exempt because of this [animal] that became mixed in, for the Merciful One states: "Whatever passes under the rod," and not that which has already passed, and each one of them is in doubt [whether] it has already passed.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:1.hebrew: ואי ס"ד ספיקא - דאיכא למימר ממה נפשך בעי לעשורי, שמא יעשה כתורה וכמצוה, נעשרינהו להנך דבתוך הדיר ממה נפשך: כל י' שיוצאין, אם מעשר שלהן בר חיוב וכראוי הוא, כגון שלא יצא אותו הקופץ לתוכן, שפיר קא מעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:1.english: And if it enters your mind [that an animal of] uncertain [status requires tithing] - For one could say that, whichever way you look at it, he is required to tithe, so that perhaps he will act in accordance with the Torah and the commandment; [if so,] let him tithe those that are inside the pen, whichever way you look at it: For every ten that emerge, if their tithe is subject to obligation and is valid, such as where that [animal] that jumped back into them did not emerge [among them], he is tithing properly.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:2.hebrew: ואי לאו בר חיובא - כגון אותן עשרה שיצא זה לתוכן, ואין עשירי שלהן מעשר:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:2.english: And if it is not subject to the obligation - Such as those ten among which this one emerged, and their tenth is not a tithe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:3.english: They are exempt - From the tithe.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:4.hebrew: במנין הראוי - שכשמנה א', ב', ג', היו בדיר טלאים הרבה שהיו ראוין להשלים, ופוטרין מניינו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 6b:9:4.english: Through a fit tally - For when he counted one, two, [and] three, there were many lambs in the pen that were fit to complete [the ten], and his tally exempts them.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:6:1.hebrew: פוטר ממונו בממון כהן - וכן הוא מסקנא, דאם תקפה כהן, מוציאין מידו. תימה, דבפ' השואל (לקמן בבא מציעא דף קב: ושם) ובפרק בית כור (ב"ב דף קה. ושם ד"ה אבל), גבי אחד ששכר מרחץ, מוקי שמואל הא דיחלוקו בבא באמצע החדש, אבל בבא בסוף החדש — כולו לשוכר; והא מסיק הכא דמוציאין מידו? וי"ל, דהתם נכנס בהיתר, לכך מהניא תפיסתו; אבל הכא לא בהיתר תפס, כי אם בספק. והא דאמרי' בפ"ב דכתובות (דף כ. ושם ד"ה ואוקי): שנים החתומים על השטר ובאו אחרים ואמרו אנוסים היו כו' אין נאמנים, ומסיק דאוקי תרי בהדי תרי ואוקי ממונא בחזקת מריה, ואין נאמנין דקאמר פרש"י: דאם תפס המלוה לא מפקינן מיניה — צ"ל שתפס קודם שבאו עדים לפסול השטר, דהיינו קודם שנולד הספק. ועי"ל, דאין נאמנין: דלא מקרעינן ליה ולא מגבינן ביה, ולא לענין תפיסה:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:6:1.english: Exempting his property with the property of a priest - And this is indeed the conclusion: that if a priest seized it, [the court] removes it from his possession. [This is] difficult: For in the chapter [entitled] HaSho'el (below, Bava Metzia 102b and there) and in the chapter [entitled] Beit Kor (Bava Batra 105b and there, s.v. Aval), regarding one who rented a bathhouse, Shmuel establishes that this [ruling] that they divide [the month's rent applies] when [the claim] came in the middle of the month; but if he came at the end of the month, it all belongs to the renter. And yet here [the Gemara] concludes that [the court] removes it from his possession?! And one can say that there, he entered [possession] lawfully; therefore, his possession is effective. But here, he did not seize [it] lawfully, but rather in [a state of] doubt. And [as for] that which we say in the second chapter of Ketubot (20a and there, s.v. Ve-okei): [Regarding] two who are signed on a document, and others came and said, "They were coerced," etc., they are not believed; and [the Gemara] concludes: Set two [witnesses] against two [witnesses], and establish the money in the possession of its owner. And as for "they are not believed" that [the baraita] states, Rashi explained that if the lender seized [property], we do not remove it from him — one must say that he seized [it] before witnesses came to disqualify the document, which is before the doubt arose. And furthermore, one can say that "they are not believed" [means] that we do not tear it [the document] up, nor do we collect with it; and [it does] not [apply] with regard to seizure.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:7:1.hebrew: ותשעה לאו בר עשורי נינהו - דאין צריך לצרפו לגורן אחר, דלא באו לעולם לכלל חיוב ודאי. ודוקא היכא דהוו עשרה מתחלה, הוא דאיצטריך לצרפו לגורן אחר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:7:1.english: And nine are not subject to tithing - For he does not need to combine them with another goren [tithing season], since they never entered the category of a definite obligation. And specifically where there were ten initially is it necessary to combine them with another goren.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:8:1.hebrew: קפץ כולן פטורין - תימה, דלבטל ברובא וליחייבו כולהו במעשר! דהא דדבר שבמנין לא בטיל – היינו מדרבנן; וקבוע נמי אין שייך אלא בדבר שהאיסור וההיתר ניכרין וידועין, ולא ידע מאיזה לקח, כגון ט' חנויות; ובריה נמי לא הוי, כדפרי' בחולין (דף צה.). ואין לומר שלא נשאר בעדר רק אחד דליכא רובא – דלשון לתוכן לא משמע הכי:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:8:1.english: [If one] jumped, all of them are exempt - [This is] astonishing: for let it be nullified in the majority, and let all of them be obligated in [animal] tithe! For that which an item that is counted is not nullified is only by rabbinic law; and [the principle of] kavua [an established source] is also only applicable to a case where the forbidden and the permitted are distinct and known, but one does not know from which [of them] he took, such as [the case of] nine shops; and it is also not [considered] a beriyah [a whole creature], as we explained in Chullin (95a). And one cannot say that only one [animal] remained in the herd, such that there is no majority, for the phrasing "into their midst" does not imply this.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:9:1.hebrew: לפטרו במנין הראוי - תימה, דהכא לא שייך מנין הראוי; דלא שייך אלא היכא דאין כי אם עשרה, והתחיל למנות ומת אחד מהן ואין כאן י', אפ"ה פטורים אותן שיצאו ולא יצטרפו לגורן אחר, כיון שתחילת יציאתן היה ראוי להשלים המנין. אבל הכא, שיש בעדר הרבה, ישלים המנין, ויהא עשירי וי"א קודש, ויקרא לשניהם עשירי מספק אם יש מנוי ביניהם אם לאו. וכן יעשה בכל אחד עשר; ובאחרונה, שלא ישאר עשרה, יצטרפו לגורן אחר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 6b:9:1.english: To exempt it through a tally fit [to reach ten] - [This is] astonishing, for here [the principle of] a tally fit [to reach ten] does not apply; as it only applies where there are no more than ten [animals], and he began counting and one of them died so that there are not ten here — even so, those that emerged are exempt and shall not combine with another threshing floor [i.e., tithing season], since when they initially emerged it was fit to complete the count. However here, where there are many [animals] in the flock, let him complete the count, and let the tenth and the eleventh be holy, and let him call both of them "tenth" out of doubt whether there is an already-counted [animal] among them or not. And so shall he do with every [group of] eleven; and with the last [group], where ten do not remain, they shall combine with another threshing floor.
